Package com.miniandmore.app.service

Class ProductColorImagesSupport

java.lang.Object
com.miniandmore.app.service.ProductColorImagesSupport
@Component public class ProductColorImagesSupport extends Object
Keeps color_images_json (Ledgerly gallery map) in sync with gallery URLs embedded in colors_json. Print swatches (swatchUrl) stay in colors_json only — never in the Ledgerly gallery map.
